lowVoltageInspection.title: Low Voltage Inspection
lowVoltageInspection.intro1: Low voltage inspection is a fundamental technical process that ensures the correct operation, safety, and regulatory compliance of electrical installations operating at voltages below 1,000V AC (alternating current) or 1,500V DC (direct current).
lowVoltageInspection.intro2: In the field of fire protection, this type of inspection is essential, as many emergencies originate from electrical faults that could have been prevented with proper inspection.

items.item1: Prevention of electrical risks and fires: Detects overloads, defective cables, loose or improperly sized connections.
items.item2: Verification of regulatory compliance: Ensures compliance with the REBT and applicable regulations.
items.item3: Protection of people and property: Minimizes the risk of electrocution and material damage.
items.item4: Guarantee of proper functioning of emergency systems: Ensures safe power supply for fire protection equipment.

items.item1: Condition and sizing of cables and conduits.
items.item2: Electrical panels and residual current devices.
items.item5: Compatibility and safety of electrical systems powering fire protection equipment.

whoPerforms.title: Who should perform it?
whoPerforms.description: These inspections must be carried out by qualified technical personnel using certified measuring instruments. In many facilities—such as public venues, industrial plants, or buildings with fire protection systems—these inspections are mandatory and periodic.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.paragraph1: At Extintores Panorámica AJ, we are committed to fire safety. Since our beginnings, we have specialized in inspection, maintenance, and prevention of fire protection systems, offering comprehensive solutions tailored to each client's needs.
aboutPage.paragraph2: Our mission is clear: to protect lives, property, and environments through high-quality technical services with a preventive approach. We operate under the strictest safety standards, both national and international regulations, using cutting-edge technology to ensure reliable and effective results.
aboutPage.paragraph3: We have a team of highly qualified professionals with extensive experience in risk detection, system inspections, and specialized technical advice. At Extintores Panorámica AJ, we don't just inspect: we anticipate, prevent, and protect.
aboutPage.paragraph4: We firmly believe that prevention is the best investment. That's why we work closely with our clients — industry, companies, institutions, and communities — to build safer and more resilient spaces against fire risks.
